reviewNotes: Preserves prior ERP/measured-pagination and CA-04/CA-05 decisions. This owner reconciliation reviews bounded JSON, exact-kind scenarios and non-formatting monetary inspection, plus explicit nested dataset schema and actual binding/UI consumers. Project schema remains the only structural contract; observed fields are not authoritative, empty collections do not invent fields, nullable values retain the existing blank binding semantics, and parent scopes retain concrete JSON Pointers. Dataset imports always create a fresh local identity, preserve source facts and reject invalid rows before mutations. Manifest stores only source/dataset/version identities; closed AI projections do not publish schema const/enum values. Existing grants, privacy, financial authority and publication/conformance evaluations remain required. The published baseline is unchanged; no universal ERP, long-layout or hardware certification is asserted. Evidence: docs/ERP_NESTED_DATASET_SCHEMA.zh-CN.md and the existing import/business contracts.
aiReadinessReview: General browser-form assistant review 2026-10-15: retains prior decisions and publication baseline. Reviews advice-only grants, post-response abort/stale barriers, restoration before publishing answers, candidate rollback after failure, exact selected alias and general write-in/declared-binding guidance through existing Pi tools. No new operation, shell, source-data authority, auto-apply or model fallback; fictional-only Demo, default-off single-run text/pixel consent and protected bindings remain. Complete Node24 build: 228 files/2416 tests. Affected three-engine profile: 204 scenarios pass without retries/skips/flaky cases, with corrected reference visibility checks also passing 21/21. Actual unmocked browser New/Blank, five viewport, keyboard and two-page PDF ingestion smoke passes with zero gateway requests/page errors. Independent runtime source review found no new blocking defect; two UI findings were repaired and covered by actual controls/drop regressions. Prior-main live read-only/handover runs remain baseline-only; exact changed-code post-deployment live evidence is separately required. No Production Ready or complete G6-G9 certification is granted.
